title: Box Seventeen
summary: The photograph surfaces. The player is not told the date yet; only that it is out of sequence. Exercises: knowledge grant, inventory, requirement on a prior storylet. Blocked after the_date. The scene is the FIRST look at box seventeen, and its curious branch SUSPECTS the stamp -- which, played after the anchor that establishes the date as known, walked the player backwards from known to suspected in about one run in six. known -> suspected is a legal transition and a deliberate one; it is just not what this scene means once the anchor has happened.
